description: Full-text search of commitfest entries (title first, then author/reviewer/committer names), in the current commitfest by default, or commitfests="all" (back to 2014) or a comma list of numbers. Websearch syntax: "phrase", -term, or. Each result: cf_id, title, status, commitfest(s), people, last update, the commitfest.postgresql.org patch url and the pg.ddx.io thread link. limit default 20, max 50. Details with get_entry; cite the patch url. Search operators apply (intitle:, from:, after:/before:, /regex/, commitfest:, release:); operators, warnings and skipped report them. Each result carries outlook: the commit model's estimate (p_cf, p_release, bands low/medium/high, health), or null.

commitfests.description: "current" (default: the commitfest commitfest.postgresql.org/current/ shows), "all", or a comma list of commitfest numbers, e.g. "62,61" or "current,55"; see /api/v2/commitfest/commitfests

query.description: Search query, e.g. NUMA or "Tom Lane". commitfest:this|next|<name> and release:this|next|PG20 keep entries the commit model estimates for that commitfest or release

sort.description: relevance (default), likely or unlikely: by the commit model's P(commit) (the release's when the query has release:), entries without an estimate last

name: search_commitfest
